blocks.text: The opening

**These are Tilde fobs: coins and tags for your keys, with an NFC sticker inside.** Tap one with a phone and it opens whatever’s on the sticker: a link, your contact card, your Wi-Fi. The tags have a QR code too. The box holds a few; here’s every shape, color and icon.
How it works

items.text: **Tap it.** Any phone with NFC reads the sticker inside, and the other person doesn’t need an app.
**Change it any time.** A phone rewrites the sticker through the plastic, so the same fob can open something new without a reprint. You only open it to replace the sticker. `[depends on U15]`
**Scan a tag.** A tag’s QR code opens a short link (up to 53 characters, such as a website). The code is printed, so it doesn’t change. A coin has no code: it’s for tapping only.
**You print it yourself** on a multi-color printer, in two pieces with no pause. Or pick up a tag at our booth.

**A tag’s size follows its link:** 28.8 × 35.3 mm for up to 17 characters, 31 × 37.5 mm for up to 32, and 35 × 41.5 mm for up to 53. A link is all a tag’s code holds: a contact card is far too much for a code this small. `[depends on U16]` for “scans”.
Colors
Three standard themes, each two colors. The code always takes the body’s color, with no patch of another color. `[depends on T-B1]` for the tilde and dark codes.
each fob type in each standard theme
**Special:** the pocket case fobs, orange with black icons. They ride in the card pocket cases (see Cards).
The model also has the cards’ themes (Signal, USA, Brasil, Portugal and Retro), or your own colors.
the orange pocket case fobs
The storage box
A 2 × 2 box of flat stacks: 3 premium coins, 3 premium tags, 5 base coins and 8 base tags, under a sliding lid with the wordmark engraved. We made it for the booth. Its print files aren’t published.
the storage box, closed and open
Icons
**Tell a set apart** with an icon on the back, and a short label if you like, in a color you choose. Every icon is generic: no brand logos, so a chat bubble rather than any app’s logo.
one image per built icon, with its name from the model and its line from `icon-uses.json`

The icons’ images and names come from the model’s export. Their one-line uses come from `site-content/icon-uses.json`, keyed by the model’s icon value, and `check_icon_uses.py` keeps the two in step. Some uses need a feature that’s still being tested:

items.text: **guest Wi-Fi on an iPhone** `[depends on T-WF]`;
the **contact card** on an iPhone `[depends on T1–T4]`.

blocks.text: The Uses page has the details.
How to get one

items.text: **Print your own.** Click **Customize** on the Tilde Keyrings listing on MakerWorld (MAKERWORLD-KEYRINGS-URL): choose a coin or a tag, Base or Premium, your colors and your icon, then download the 3MF. `[depends on keyrings listing]`
**Add a round NFC sticker** and write it with Tilde (Android: Cards → Write a sticker) or the free NFC Tools app (iPhone and Android).
**Or pick one up at our booth.** Take a tag from the giveaway boxes, and we’ll show you how to write it (see the Uses page).
